ticket.summary: Dinner-plate-sized damp yellow stain on bedroom ceiling (Apt 5C) directly below upstairs neighbor's bathroom; 3 days old, stable, no drip, no sag, no odor - needs leak diagnosis, may require neighbor access.
mitigation_advice: If the patch begins to sag or hold water, stay clear of it and do not puncture it; call us immediately [PB-08]
If water ever starts running and can't be stopped, shut off the unit/house main - wheel clockwise or lever perpendicular to the pipe [PB-02]

quote_lines.description: Diagnostic visit / camera inspection to locate ceiling leak source

ticket.customer_message: You're all set - Tue Sep 1, 10:30 AM at 230 Quarry Rd, Apt 5C, diagnostic visit ($89, ~45 min). Meanwhile: if the patch starts sagging or holding water, stay out from under it and don't poke it - call us right away [PB-08]. And if water ever starts running where you can't stop it, shut off the house/unit main (clockwise, or lever perpendicular to the pipe) [PB-02]. It'd help to let your neighbor know we may need a peek at their bathroom.
